description: This file defines the StringUtils object containing utility functions for string manipulation, specifically join and split, which operate on a custom LinkedList class.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string utility functions, delegating to JoinUtils and SplitUtils.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Concatenates a LinkedList into a String using JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList using SplitUtils.
